doc.audio_prop_crossfade: Whether to crossfade between tracks (or the duration in seconds)
doc.audio_prop_customControls: Whether to use the custom control bar instead of native controls
doc.audio_prop_demoDelay: Demo only: milliseconds to intentionally delay load completion
doc.audio_prop_fadeIn: Whether to fade in when playback starts (or the duration in seconds)
doc.audio_prop_fadeOut: Whether to fade out when playback ends (or the duration in seconds)
doc.audio_prop_loading: Loading behavior. With "lazy", an Intersection Observer is enabled.
doc.audio_prop_playbackRate: Whether to show the playback-rate control
doc.audio_prop_showMetadata: Whether to show track metadata (title, artist, cover art)
doc.audio_prop_sleepTimer: Whether to show the sleep timer
doc.audio_prop_src: Source: a URL, list of URLs, or track object(s)
doc.audio_prop_tracks: Subtitle/caption tracks passed as <track> elements (kind, src, srcLang, label).
doc.audio_prop_visualizer: Whether to show the audio visualizer
doc.gallery_prop_aspect: Aspect ratio for each image. Default: "square".
doc.gallery_prop_items: Images to display in the gallery
doc.gallery_prop_onItemClick: Called when the item (not the checkbox) is clicked. Fires even when selectable.
doc.gallery_prop_renderActions: Render bulk-action toolbar when items are selected.
doc.gallery_prop_selectable: Enable multi-select with checkboxes. The photo click is `onItemClick`, not select.
doc.icon_prop_component: Icon component passed directly. Works without registration and is tree-shakable.
doc.icon_prop_name: Icon name. Requires `import "wimui/icons"` once at the app entry to register icons.
doc.imageCompare_prop_after: Source URL of the "after" image (revealed on the trailing side)
doc.imageCompare_prop_afterAlt: Alternative text for the after image
doc.imageCompare_prop_afterLabel: Badge label overlaid on the after side
doc.imageCompare_prop_before: Source URL of the "before" image (revealed on the leading side)
doc.imageCompare_prop_beforeAlt: Alternative text for the before image
doc.imageCompare_prop_beforeLabel: Badge label overlaid on the before side
doc.imageCompare_prop_defaultPosition: Initial divider position as a percentage 0–100 (uncontrolled)
doc.imageCompare_prop_onPositionChange: Callback when the divider position changes
doc.image_prop_backdropFilter: Filter applied to the background (effective with transparent images)
doc.image_prop_blendMode: Blend mode of the image itself
doc.image_prop_demoDelay: Demo only: milliseconds to intentionally delay load completion
doc.image_prop_fadeIn: Whether to fade in when loading completes
doc.image_prop_fallback: Custom element shown when loading fails
doc.image_prop_filter: Filter applied to the image itself
doc.image_prop_fit: How the image fits its box
doc.image_prop_hoverBackdropFilter: Filter applied to the background on hover
doc.image_prop_hoverFilter: Filter applied on hover (when omitted, `filter` is kept)
doc.image_prop_priority: Whether to raise loading priority (e.g. an LCP candidate; sets fetchpriority="high")
doc.image_prop_tilt: Tilt effect that follows the mouse
doc.image_prop_zoom: Zoom factor on hover (e.g. 1.1) or true (defaults to 1.05)
doc.lightbox_prop_defaultIndex: Index of the item shown first
doc.lightbox_prop_defaultOpen: Initial open state for uncontrolled usage
doc.lightbox_prop_onOpenChange: Callback when the open state changes
doc.lightboxGallery_prop_children: Thumbnails for the strip (`Lightbox.Trigger`). Not a `Gallery` grid.
doc.lightboxGallery_prop_items: Items registered on the Lightbox for the overlay.
doc.video_prop_advancedControls: Whether to enable advanced controls (quality, playback rate, etc.)
doc.video_prop_autoPlayNext: Whether to automatically play the next playlist item
doc.video_prop_customControls: Whether to use the custom control bar instead of native controls
doc.video_prop_demoDelay: Demo only: milliseconds to intentionally delay load completion
doc.video_prop_fadeIn: Whether to fade in when loading completes
doc.video_prop_fit: How the video fits its box
doc.video_prop_loading: Loading behavior. With "lazy", an Intersection Observer is enabled.
doc.video_prop_playlist: Playlist of videos to play in sequence
doc.video_prop_resumePlayback: Whether to resume playback from the last saved position
doc.video_prop_tracks: Subtitle/caption tracks passed as <track> elements (kind, src, srcLang, label).
doc.video_prop_videoId: Unique ID used to persist and resume playback position
